description.p: FlatCAM Plus turns PCB artwork into machine instructions. It imports Gerber, Excellon, DXF and SVG files and produces isolation routing, drilling, cutout and milling toolpaths, then emits G-code through a selectable preprocessor.

ul.li: Isolation routing, drilling, cutout, panelization and copper clearing
G-code preprocessors for GRBL, Marlin, Mach3 and others
3D preview of the generated job and a pen-plotter workflow
